description.en: The unique identifier for real-person authentication.

description.zh:
删除时是否依赖已获取到对应认证流程中的相关数据。

- Y：需要。如果需成功删除相关数据，必须已通过DescribeFaceVerify接口获取处理结果。
- N：不需要（默认）。通过纯服务端API集成模式时可直接传入N。
description.en:
Specifies whether deletion depends on having retrieved the relevant data from the corresponding authentication process.

- Y: Required. To successfully delete the relevant data, you must have already obtained the processing result through the DescribeFaceVerify API.
- N: Not required (default). You can directly pass N when integrating through the pure server-side API mode.

title.zh: 金融级新增服务删除接口

descriptions.zh: 删除请求信息中个人信息相关的全部字段信息：姓名、身份证、手机号、ip、图片、视频、设备信息等
descriptions.en: Deletes all personal information fields from the request, including name, ID card number, phone number, IP address, images, videos, device information, etc.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth delete-face-verify-result --certify-id shae18209d29ce4e8ba252caae98ab15 --delete-after-query Y --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth DeleteFaceVerifyResult --region cn-hangzhou --CertifyId shae18209d29ce4e8ba252caae98ab15 --DeleteAfterQuery Y
